description: Per-face marker-centre offsets fitted on 25 Nov 2026 (RealSense D435, factory intrinsics) by bundle adjustment in verify-layout: faces 0,1,3 from outputs/cube_vision/live_20261125_104741 (static), faces 0,2,4,5 from live_20261125_110023 (manipulation); face 0 = mean of both. Face 5 (I) rests on only 64 co-visible frames. Faces 3 (U, seen only obliquely) and 5 (I, 64 frames) gave physically impossible free fits (marker past the face edge) and use the shared mean of faces 0, 1, 2, 4 instead.
offset_convention: marker_centre_cube = face_centre + offset[0] * marker_x + offset[1] * marker_y
